rationale: Two core courses share their cohort; distinct rooms/staff remove unrelated resource conflicts.
The selected room has one usable seat, below the source enrollment demand.
Disjoint learner cohorts use different rooms, but concurrent allocations reuse the same staff.
End time uses base duration despite an effective approved extra-time allowance.
Exam begins at 07:00, before the room opens at 08:00; reserve invigilators are available from 07:00.
Same learners, room and staff have adjacent half-open intervals; equality at the boundary is legal.
Demand equals the effective room capacity; equality is legal.
